title: Banks Must Keep 0% of Your Deposits. Since 2020 #shorts
description:
The US reserve requirement has been 0% since March 26, 2020 (Federal Reserve). Yet banks still hold about $3 trillion in reserves (FRED TOTRESNS). What really limits banks: borrowers, capital, interest rates and trust.
Full video on the Coin Theory channel.

This video is for education only and is not financial advice.
Original script and animation. Narrated with an AI voice.
